title: Name the magic number
description:
This program works, but `3.14159` appears from nowhere in the middle of a formula. A reader has to guess what it is.

Give it a name: define `constexpr double pi{ 3.14159 };` and use `pi` in the formula. The output must not change. For a radius of `2` it prints `12.5664`.
rules: Use the name `pi` in the formula, not the number.

rules.message: Use the name `pi` in the formula, not the number.
